caption:
Wrote the IIM B UGAT on 15 Nov? Check your score in under a minute 👇

1. Copy your response sheet link (log in with the link IIM B shared)
2. Open our free calculator: register.ipmcareer.com/response-v1 (link in our Story)
3. Fill your details and paste the link. Link not opening? Save the page as HTML and upload it
4. Tap Analyse My Score

You get QADI, LR and VARC scores, your total out of 180, accuracy and what negative marking cost you.

This is your raw score (+3 right, -1 wrong). IIM B standardises scores for the shortlist, so official numbers can differ.

Send this to a friend who wrote it too 📌

#IIMBUGAT #IIMBangalore #IPMCareers #ScoreCalculator #BBA
